name: Release Notes Writer
description: Example skill that turns a reviewed set of commits into concise, audience-aware release notes without inventing changes.

installation.notes: Adapt the audience and repository conventions in the example skill before using it in a real project.

usage.instructions: Provide the release range or reviewed commit list, the intended audience, and links that should appear in the final notes.
usage.example: Write user-facing release notes for v1.4.0 from the supplied commits. Separate improvements, fixes, and upgrade notes.
